items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: we all worked together. ... Simmons and Chris.

ctx.x: Oh, I don't understand it. What would Chris play on an advertisement when he buck with somebody? Would he play a fast number or would he play a blues or what would he play?
Oh, man, Chris had a variety number. Oh, man.
But when he's bucking somebody, what number would he play? Did he have a real crip that he could beat him with? Oh, he played.
